messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated error rate detected for serving cluster us-west-2. Error spike: 5xxs and runtime crashes. Pager duty notified.

maria (oncall): I see the page — looking now. which customer buckets are affected?

ashok (sre): Packet loss on IB fabric between rack-6 and rack-7 started ~10:04. kdump shows repeated timeouts and some nodes dropped from the RDMA mesh. Symptoms: higher tail latency, kworker stalls.

sam (runtime): Getting a bunch of container crashes from serving-runtime on gnode-6-03: CUDA driver log includes `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` then `out of memory` on subsequent restarts. Also seeing KV cache mis-sizes.

lina (infra): Network telemetry shows sudden increase in retransmits on sw-06 port 3/1, prime suspect is a link flapping after an MTU negotiation failure. MTU on that path changed to 65520 then reverted.

ben (eng-sre): Confirmed: `ib_sr_cq_error: remote packet truncated` and `dma mapping error` entries on 6-03. Might be hardware NIC offload corruption.

maria (oncall): Is this causing customer-facing errors? customer-success, can you chime in?

customer-success: We have 3 heavy customers reporting timeouts for embeddings and chats. One timed out 5 requests in last 2 minutes. They're noticing elevated latency, some 502/503 proxy errors.

ashok (sre): Impact estimate: ~8% of production serving capacity degraded due to retries and OOM-driven restarts. If link flaps continue, we expect more node flaps which will push autoscaler and possibly overload remaining nodes.

sam (runtime): Immediate mitigation plan: 1) cordon + drain gnode-6-03 and any nodes with repeated RDMA errors; 2) disable RDMA for serving pool temporarily (fallback to TCP RDMA-free path) for critical customers; 3) scale up CPU-hosted fallback replicas for latency-sensitive routes.

lina (infra): I'll quiesce traffic on sw-06 port and force a negotiated MTU to 4096 on the path to remove jumbo negotiation instability. Doing a staged change now.

ashok (sre): Draining node gnode-6-03 now: `kubectl drain gnode-6-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — re-scheduling in progress.

sam (runtime): PATCH to runtime: adding env var to disable RDMA backend: `SERVE_RDMA=0` for the critical deployment. Rolling canary to 2 pods first.

maria (oncall): :thumbsup: please keep canary small and monitor 5xxs. ashok, any risk to storage/etcd from node moves?

ashok (sre): Minimal. KV cache will warm slowly on new pods; might see token cost bump but acceptable.

ben (eng-sre): Observability note: adding ephemeral tracing to the affected routes to capture failing requests for postmortem.

incident-bot: Route: `/alerts/1848002222` created. Severity: Sev2. Runbook: RDMA_NETLINK. Handoff window set to 20:00 UTC.

maria (oncall): Lina, status on link change?

lina (infra): MTU forced to 4096 on sw-06 -> path now stable for 90s. Retransmits dropped from 12/s to 0.6/s. I'm keeping port quiesced for 5m.

sam (runtime): Canary results: 2 pods with RDMA disabled are stable and processing requests. 5xxs on the route dropped from 4.5% to 0.6% after canary. Rolling to 20% now.

customer-success: Customers reporting improvement for the routes moved to fallback. We'll message customers in the next 10m with mitigation summary.

ashok (sre): Noted one node gnode-6-07 still showing sporadic `rdma: sendmsg -110` and occasional `ib_ker` errors. I've isolated it and set `no_iba_offload=1` at kernel cmdline for test.

sam (runtime): Observed `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` stack traces include this pattern:

```
[serving] kernel: ib_uhca: CQE error 0x17 on qp 0x2b
[serving] runtime: nvml: GPU 0: Xid 71 (CE): GPU page fault
[serving] runtime: torch/cuda runtime: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS
```

This matches RDMA corruption leading to GPU faults on some workloads.

maria (oncall): Given the customer impact and in-flight mitigations, declaring incident active. Status: mitigated for critical customers via RDMA-disable and node drains. Next focus: durable fix and rollback plan.

ben (eng-sre): Short term: keep RDMA disabled for the critical pool for 2h. Long term: we need to audit NIC firmware and switch port logs; possible firmware rollback.

lina (infra): I'll open a ticket with the switch vendor and request MTU negotiation logs and SFP diagnostics. Also scheduling NIC firmware version dump across rack-6.

ashok (sre): Will run a targeted memtest and IB stress on gnode-6-07 after drain. If passes, we'll re-enable offload slowly. If not, we'll mark hardware-replacement.

maria (oncall): Any config changes that need a change control? We forced MTU and set kernel cmdline flags. Ben, file CHG-2026-IB-1 and link to this thread.

ben (eng-sre): Filed CHG-2026-IB-1: temporary MTU harden and RDMA-disable for critical pool. Change window 30m. Link: https://rdrw.atlassian/CHG-2026-IB-1

incident-bot: Paging note: Next oncall in 2h is ashok. Handoff reminder scheduled.

maria (oncall): Ok team, my summary for handoff: Incident ID 1848002222 — root cause suspected RDMA link flaps causing packet corruption -> GPU faults -> serving OOMs/crashes. Immediate mitigations: forced MTU to 4096 on sw-06, drained flapping nodes, disabled RDMA in critical serving pool, scaled CPU fallbacks, and opened vendor ticket. Customer impact reduced to intermittent non-critical timeouts.

ashok (sre): Next steps for oncall: telemetry collection (ibstat logs, dmesg, nvml logs) from affected nodes; run hardware checks; keep RDMA disabled until firmware/port investigation complete.

sam (runtime): I'll prepare a runtime patch to automatically detect RDMA CQE corruption and fallback gracefully within pod (toggle SERVE_RDMA at runtime) so we avoid full pod crashes next time. PR will be up in 30m.

customer-success: We'll send customer-facing note: short summary, mitigation, ETA for full resolution (TBD), and workaround (we've routed their traffic to TCP-backed instances).

maria (oncall): Handoff: I'm passing to ashok for the next 2h. I'm leaving the thread open for vendor updates and the PR. ashok — you're the responder. :hand:

ashok (sre): Taking the watch. I'll coordinate with Lina for vendor comms and Sam for runtime patch. If everything stays stable, we'll begin controlled re-enable tests in 4h.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded: from maria to ashok at 1848002822.

maria (oncall): Thanks all. Marking this thread as ongoing; will close once firmware/port root cause is found and RDMA re-enable plan validated. :white_check_mark:
